Item Class: Waystones
Rarity: Rare
Shrouded Halls
Waystone (Tier 15)
--------
Waystone Tier: 15
Revives Available: 0 (augmented)
Pack Size: +18% (augmented)
Magic Monsters: +35% (augmented)
Rare Monsters: +28% (augmented)
Item Rarity: +46% (augmented)
Waystone Drop Chance: +210% (augmented)
--------
Item Level: 81
--------
Monsters deal 26% of Damage as Extra Lightning
Monsters have 20% increased Area of Effect
Area has patches of Shocked Ground
Players have 40% less Recovery Rate of Life and Energy Shield
Monsters fire 2 additional Projectiles
Monsters have 70% increased Freeze Buildup
--------
Can be used in a Map Device, allowing you to enter a Map. Waystones can only be used once.
